title: expand_url_template missing UTF-8 encoding note
description: blob.rs expand_url_template (lines 26-41): doc explains RFC 3986 unreserved characters pass through and others are percent-encoded, but does not say what happens with multi-byte UTF-8 values. Each byte is independently percent-encoded per RFC 3986 section 2.5 — this is correct but non-obvious to callers. Suggested fix: add one sentence to the doc comment noting this behavior.
